items.summary: Centene lifted its guidance for the year after revenue and profit growth in the second quarter were driven by strength in its core government-sponsored and individual healthcare lines.

items.title: Centene’s (NYSE:CNC) Q2 CY2026: Strong Sales, Guides for Strong Full-Year Sales
items.summary: Health coverage company Centene (NYSE:CNC) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 9.9% year on year to $53.58 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $195.5 billion at the midpoint came in 2.7% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.51 per share was significantly above analysts’ consensus estimates.
